lock.note: the LaunchServices lock is no longer contended at 900 s

lsd.state: one mach message wait and three idle work queue threads

findings: The LaunchServices deadlock is gone at 900 s: waits=0 and SpringBoard's main thread sits in its run loop with 34 threads alive.
The persistent Data store is being written: free blocks fell from about 78k to 26.4k, roughly 200 MiB of changes.
The panel is black because the display path barely presents: six swaps in 900 s, four copies, and the synthetic vsync was never armed or notified.
Read-ahead is counterproductive here: 3771 prefetches produced only 35 hits, so it added roughly 480 MiB of extra reads.
conclusion: the boot reaches a running SpringBoard; the remaining blocker for a visible UI is frame presentation and vsync, not the userland lock chain
